latestVersion.changelog:
Template refresh for safer OpenClaw companion setups.

Highlights:
- Recommend dedicated persistent companion sessions for live cron jobs (for example session:companion-owner).
- Clarify that main + systemEvent remains legacy-compatible but can bleed into heartbeat or owner-chat context.
- Refresh live cron templates to include explicit session routing and explicit delivery targets.
- Align the top-level SKILL.md architecture guidance with the updated OpenClaw integration docs.

Notes:
- Documentation/template release only; pacing/state script behavior is unchanged.
